sentences: A black hole is a massive, compact astronomical object so dense that its gravity prevents anything from escaping, even light.
Albert Einstein's theory of general relativity predicts that a sufficiently compact mass will form a black hole.
The boundary of no escape is called the event horizon.
Objects whose gravitational fields are too strong for light to escape were first considered in the 18th century by John Michell and Pierre-Simon Laplace.
In 1916, Karl Schwarzschild found the first modern solution of general relativity that would characterise a black hole.
